mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a weakening demand environment, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of more than 0.3% in the last month signals a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% and PAYEMS declines > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO has been below 105.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and residential construction (HOUST) indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), a federal funds rate above 0.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.
